rdfs:label: Wallet
rdfs:comment: A part of a Solid pod that holds credentials and related items (verifiable credentials, identity documents, keys, tickets); names the storage only — presentation and signing are the job of wallet applications.
notes: Conventional storage location on a pod for credential-class items. Intended as a pane target for `solidos:Wallet` in SolidOS / mashlib-style data browsers. Often appears as a sub-container at `<pod>/wallet/` registered via the public or private TypeIndex. The upstream solidos vocabulary marks this term unstable upstream (term_status 'unstable').

examples.title: Pod sub-container declared as a Wallet

history.note: Comment aligned with upstream (names storage only); removed unverified mashlib pane claim; notes flag the term as unstable upstream.
